RHCA — Human Resources & Access Control

Enterprise application supporting employee identity management, organizational structures, employment relationship validation, and access governance.

Organization: Municipal Government of João Pessoa (PMJP)

Oracle APEX / PL/SQL / Oracle Database / SQL / LDAP / DBMS_LDAP

Professional enterprise project — Proprietary source code is not publicly available.

My technical contributions
